findings.description: SWR-SAF-009 requires an elapsed-time addition at detection only where SWR-SAF-011 makes one, but SWR-SAF-011 specifies no condition requiring an update at detection. Consequently, the elapsed time used to evaluate the 60 s threshold is ambiguous.
findings.requested_change: Define the elapsed-time value to be used at detection in terms of operational time and the permitted error bounds, without relying on an unspecified update.

findings.description: SWR-SAF-011 requires the elapsed time to be equal to the operational time while also allowing it to under-count that time. Exact equality conflicts with the permitted under-count in CON-SUP-136 and leaves the acceptance criterion unclear.
findings.requested_change: State the permitted relationship between elapsed and actual operational time consistently with the under-count bounds of CON-SUP-136.
